data.description: claude-opus-5-5 是 Anthropic 全新旗舰大模型，拥有百万级上下文，自适应思考不可关闭，Agent 与代码能力突出，速度更快、定价更低，适合复杂长任务。
GPT-6.1-Sol 是 OpenAI 推出的 GPT-6 Sol 升级版推理模型，在智能体编程、计算机操作与专业复杂任务上能力贴近旗舰 GPT-6 Astra

Gemini-3.8-Flash is the general availability (GA) flagship multimodal model, designed for code development and AI agent scenarios. It supports configurable reasoning depth, offers a million-token context window, and is compatible with image, text, audio, and video inputs. With standout capabilities in tool invocation and multi-step task execution, it is well-suited for large-scale production workloads.
gpt-image-2-c,支持返回url，base64,支持1k图片生成，gpt-image-2分组支持1k、2k、4k。暂不支持n参数

AI video generation model supporting text-to-video, image-to-video, and video continuation. Available in multiple versions including Video-O1 and V1.0 through V2.6, with standard (std) and high-quality (pro) modes. Supports durations of 5, 10, and 15 seconds. Some versions also support audio generation and voice customization.
万相3.0是 all-in-one 视频生成模型，统一支持参考、编辑、复刻、驱动等多种创作功能，四模态全能参考，最长支持30秒视频生成，可解析文件、网页及复杂图片。生产级角色一致性保持，音画真实，带来身临其境的视听冲击力。
OpenAI's third-generation embedding model, more capable than the small version, suited for tasks requiring maximum performance.

Doubao-Seed-2.0-lite is a balanced model for high-frequency enterprise scenarios, trading performance against cost. It surpasses the previous-generation Doubao-Seed-1.8 in overall capability, handling unstructured information processing, content creation, search and recommendation, and data analysis. Supports long context, multi-source information fusion, multi-step instruction execution, and high-fidelity structured output — delivering consistent results at significantly reduced cost.

en.description: Adding the prefix "new-" to the model name can resolve certain client model compatibility issues!! Some models support distinguishing between thinking and not thinking, ending with -thinking or -nothinking, and support custom -thinking-* levels of thinking (156-24576)
